description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe at Ghost Ranch in the courtyard patio.  Behind her is a view of the portale and her kiva ladder with a view of clouds above the roof line. She faces the camera wearing a black suit jacket with her Alexander Calder silver brooch over a white button-up collared shirt, and a white flowing head scarf under her signature black wide brim hat (with a telescope crease/bash) with her hand on her arm.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Ghost Ranch
